name: Corporate Action Event
definition: An event determined by a corporation's board of directors, that changes the existing corporate capital structure or financial condition.

MandatoryVoluntaryEventType.name: Mandatory Voluntary Event Type
MandatoryVoluntaryEventType.definition: Specifies whether the event is mandatory, mandatory with options or voluntary.

RegistrationDetails.name: Registration Details
RegistrationDetails.definition: Provides information required for the registration.

BasketOrIndexInformation.name: Basket Or Index Information
BasketOrIndexInformation.definition: Provides additional information on the basket or index underlying a security, for example a warrant.

AdditionalBusinessProcess.name: Additional Business Process
AdditionalBusinessProcess.definition: Specifies the type of the additional business process linked to a corporate action event such as a claim compensation or tax refund.

TradingDate.name: Trading Date
TradingDate.definition: Date/time at which the deal (rights) was agreed.

PariPassuDate.name: Pari Passu Date
PariPassuDate.definition: Date on which security will assimilate, become fungible, or have the same rights to dividends as the parent issue.

InformationConditions.name: Information Conditions
InformationConditions.definition: Provides conditional information related to the event, eg, an offer is subject to 50% acceptance, the offeror allows the securities holder to set some conditions.

EventProcessingType.name: Event Processing Type
EventProcessingType.definition: Type of processing involved by a Corporate Action.

AnnouncementDate.name: Announcement Date
AnnouncementDate.definition: Date/time at which the issuer announced that a corporate action event will occur such as the issue of securities or an official meeting.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date/time at which an event is officially effective from the issuer's perspective.

FurtherDetailsAnnouncementDate.name: Further Details Announcement Date
FurtherDetailsAnnouncementDate.definition: Date/time at which additional information on the event will be announced, for instance exchange ratio announcement date.

MarginFixingDate.name: Margin Fixing Date
MarginFixingDate.definition: Date/time at which the margin rate will be determined .

ResultPublicationDate.name: Result Publication Date
ResultPublicationDate.definition: Date on which results are published, eg, results of an offer, of a meeting.

UnconditionalDate.name: Unconditional Date
UnconditionalDate.definition: Date upon which the terms of the take-over become unconditional as to acceptances.

WhollyUnconditionalDate.name: Wholly Unconditional Date
WhollyUnconditionalDate.definition: Date on which all conditions, including regulatory, legal etc. pertaining to the take-over, have been met.

LapsedDate.name: Lapsed Date
LapsedDate.definition: Date/time at which an event/offer is terminated or lapsed.

RestrictionIndicator.name: Restriction Indicator
RestrictionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there are legal or other restrictions associated with a rights offer or other corporate event, for example, domicile, citizenship, residency, type of investor.|Yes = There are restrictions.|No = There are no restrictions.

EventStage.name: Event Stage
EventStage.definition: Stage in the corporate action event life cycle.

PartialElectionIndicator.name: Partial Election Indicator
PartialElectionIndicator.definition: Specifies if the issuer will allow the agent to accept partial elections. It is to allow split voting over options. It allows the client to elect more than one option to be selected per designated holding.

MarginType.name: Margin Type
MarginType.definition: Specifies the margin type for a remarketing procedure.

ConsentType.name: Consent Type
ConsentType.definition: Corporate actions may be approved by shareholders without a meeting or a vote by means of execution of a consent by a majority of shareholders entitled to vote.

TaxOnNonDistributedProceedsIndicator.name: Tax On Non Distributed Proceeds Indicator
TaxOnNonDistributedProceedsIndicator.definition: Specifies the tax regulation being attributed to the  non- distributed proceeds event.

AcceptancePriorityLevel.name: Acceptance Priority Level
AcceptancePriorityLevel.definition: Level of priority of the given offer which will be accepted by the issuer/agent within the tiered structure of the event.|Offer events in many cases are subject to proration.

DutchAuctionType.name: Dutch Auction Type
DutchAuctionType.definition: Specifies whether a Dutch auction is modified or unmodified.

ReverseDutchAuctionIndicator.name: Reverse Dutch Auction Indicator
ReverseDutchAuctionIndicator.definition: Indicates that the Dutch Auction event is a Reverse Dutch Auction.

UnderlyingSecurity.name: Underlying Security
UnderlyingSecurity.definition: Security to which this instruction or event applies.

CorporateActionPrice.name: Corporate Action Price
CorporateActionPrice.definition: Specifies prices related to a corporate action.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Rate, specified by the issuer, when the paid amount is not in the same currency as the specified amount.

Deadline.name: Deadline
Deadline.definition: Specifies the different deadlines related to a corporate event.

CorporateActionCharge.name: Corporate Action Charge
CorporateActionCharge.definition: Specifies the charges relative to a corporate action event.

FractionalQuantity.name: Fractional Quantity
FractionalQuantity.definition: Fractional quantity resulting from an event which will be paid with cash in lieu.

CorporateActionStatus.name: Corporate Action Status
CorporateActionStatus.definition: Status of the corporate action process.

BookClosurePeriod.name: Book Closure Period
BookClosurePeriod.definition: Period defining the last date on which shareholder registration will be accepted by the issuer and the date on which shareholder registration will resume.

SecuritiesQuantity.name: Securities Quantity
SecuritiesQuantity.definition: Provides information about securities quantity linked to a corporate action.

DocumentationLocation.name: Documentation Location
DocumentationLocation.definition: Information on where additional information published for the event, can be received. for instance the address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), eg, used over the www (HTTP) service.

SecuritiesQuantitySought.name: Securities Quantity Sought
SecuritiesQuantitySought.definition: Quantity of securities the offeror/issuer will purchase or redeem under the terms of the event. This can be a number or the term "any and all".

CorporateActionPartyRole.name: Corporate Action Party Role
CorporateActionPartyRole.definition: Specifies the role played by a party in the context of a corporate action.

BiddingConditions.name: Bidding Conditions
BiddingConditions.definition: Specifies the conditions under which securities can be acquired as part of a corporate action.

RelatedClassAction.name: Related Class Action
RelatedClassAction.definition: Specifies the underlying class action related to the event.

SuspensionPeriod.name: Suspension Period
SuspensionPeriod.definition: Period defining the last date for which an action will be accepted and the date on which the suspension will be released and normal processing will resume.

Lottery.name: Lottery
Lottery.definition: Organisation of draws for cash prizes on bonds (instead of coupon payments). Every issued bond (similar to a lottery ticket) has an equal opportunity at winning payments in the draws.

RelatedMeeting.name: Related Meeting
RelatedMeeting.definition: Provides information on the meeting  related to the corporate event.

Services.name: Services
Services.definition: Specifies the different services linked to a corporate action event.

Issuance.name: Issuance
Issuance.definition: Information specified when the corporate event relates to the issuance of securities.

SecuritiesModification.name: Securities Modification
SecuritiesModification.definition: Modification of the reference data of a security or of the organisation that issued it.

TradingPeriod.name: Trading Period
TradingPeriod.definition: Period during which a financial instrument is available for trading.

TransactionTax.name: Transaction Tax
TransactionTax.definition: Tax rate of financial transactions related to an event.

ProceedsDefinition.name: Proceeds Definition
ProceedsDefinition.definition: Specifies the proceeds of a corporate action.

FiscalYearPeriod.name: Fiscal Year Period
FiscalYearPeriod.definition: Period defining the fiscal or tax year the dividend pertains to in order to correctly deduct taxes for residents.
